r2_over_training.caption: Plotted: as the lead figure of this experiment, for the r = 2 sets of the time block b9 over all 8 checkpoints, kernel rule kNN graph, k = 15: within-minus-between cosine of whole-model per-image loss gradients (y) at each checkpoint (x, symlog), on the 1,795 images the sets assign. Solid blue: the sets; solid orange: their class-union grouping on the same images; dashed blue with band: within-class permutation null (mean, 2.5 to 97.5 percentiles of 200); dashed grey with band: permutation of the set labels among the assigned images.

every_site.xlabel: site whose time block defines the grouping

series.name: sets of each site's time block (r = 4)

every_site.caption: Plotted: groupings from each site's time block, whole-model gradients. For each site (x), the r = 4 sets of that site's time block over all 8 checkpoints (kernel rule kNN graph, k = 15) and the within-minus-between cosine (y) of the same per-image loss gradients (all parameters) at step 64,000. The gradients are identical in every column; only the grouping changes. Blue: the sets; orange: their class-union grouping on the same assigned images; dashed blue with band: within-class permutation null (100 draws, 2.5 to 97.5 percentiles); dashed grey: 97.5th percentile of the permutation of set labels among assigned images.

setalign.ylabel: mean cosine with the mean probe gradient
setalign.caption: Plotted: for each r = 4 set of the time block b9 over all 8 checkpoints (kernel rule kNN graph, k = 15), the mean over its members of the cosine between the image's loss gradient (all parameters) and the mean loss gradient of the probe (y), at each checkpoint (x, symlog); dashed: the mean over all probe images.

class_counts.caption: Plotted: number of probe images of each class (columns) in each r = 4 set (rows) of the time block b9 over all 8 checkpoints, kernel rule kNN graph, k = 15; unassigned images are not counted. The class-union grouping gives each class (column) to the row with its largest count.

lossgrad_overlap.ylabel: overlap of leading spans (mean cos² of principal angles)
lossgrad_overlap.caption: Plotted: label-dependent reference. Overlap (mean squared cosine of principal angles) of each site's leading r modes (single snapshot, step 64,000, kernel rule kNN graph, k = 15, cosine site kernel) with the leading r modes of the loss-gradient-cosine sample kernel through the same rule (the loss uses the labels). Dotted: r/N, the expected overlap of random spans (scale reference, not a control).

ggn_r10.ylabel: overlap of leading spans (mean cos² of principal angles)
ggn_r10.caption: Plotted: as the GGN/NTK figure of this experiment, at r = 10: overlap of each site's leading ten modes (single snapshot, step 64,000, kernel rule kNN graph, k = 15, cosine site kernel) with the leading ten modes of the GGN-cos and NTK-cos sample kernels (label-free) through the same rule. Dotted: r/N (scale reference).

ggn_dotsite.ylabel: overlap of leading spans (mean cos² of principal angles)
ggn_dotsite.caption: Plotted: overlap of each site's leading four modes with the leading four modes of the GGN-cos and NTK-cos sample kernels (label-free), step 64,000, kernel rule kNN graph, k = 15; solid: the site kernel in its default cosine form; dashed: the dot (Euclidean) site kernel of Appendix A.

ggn_over_training.ylabel: overlap of leading spans (mean cos² of principal angles)
ggn_over_training.caption: Plotted: overlap of b9's leading four modes (single snapshot at each checkpoint, kernel rule kNN graph, k = 15, cosine site kernel) with the leading four modes of the GGN-cos and NTK-cos sample kernels at the same checkpoint (lines, label-free) and of the loss-gradient-cosine kernel (dots, label-dependent), against training step (x, symlog). Dotted: r/N (scale reference).
